articles.summary: Go 1.24’s Swiss Tables cut our map memory usage by up to 70% in high-traffic workloads. Here’s how we profiled the savings and improved performance.
articles.title: How Go 1.24’s Swiss Tables saved us hundreds of gigabytes

articles.summary: We rolled out Go 1.24 and saw a memory regression. Here’s how we dug into system metrics, uncovered a bug in the runtime allocator, and worked with the Go team to help fix it.
articles.title: How we tracked down a Go 1.24 memory regression across hundreds of pods
